Observing a mock race by Mejiro McQueen, a 
top contender for the Tenno Sho (Spring).

Even while overwhelmed by her popularity 
and skill... The two reaffirm that they 
share the exact same desire to win.

To Mihono Bourbon, the desire to "win" had 
once been nothing more than an unpleasant 
distraction.

However, she now felt that surrendering 
herself to that intense passion was 
actually comforting.
